title: much ado about jamie lloyd. ✨💗 #westendtheatre #londontheatre #ukthea...
transcript: Loki and Peggy Carter have fallen in love Jamie Lloyd has found color truly the world may never be the same a few years ago my brother and I watched every single Marvel movie in order but after we finished Endgame we like never caught back up probably in like five years we could do the series again with all new movies all this to say I wasn't sure I was going to see ‘much ado about nothing’ because it seemed like a play for MCU superfans and I could not picture a Jamie Lloyd comedy but my friend MK changed her flight because she loves Hayley and as soon as we walked in I realized this was not Romeo and Juliet everything was disco balls and pink confetti they're playing Party Rock Anthem And that vibe very much carried over into the show itself much ado was deeply silly, even absurd this is the best decision we've ever made this is so funny I'm losing my mind ‘much to do about nothing’ is one of my favorite Shakespeare plays I love a romantic comedy and Jamie Lloyd has directed maybe my favorite version of it ever the cast was so good Mason Alexander Park is out there in the cutest PJs you've ever seen in your life just killing it on vocal like they sing a ton and they sounds so good and then of course Tom Hiddleston and Hayley Atwell are two of the most charming people you’ve ever seen in your life they made me giggle I was like so giddy during Tom’s big love confession scene there are things I don't want to spoil that made me like cry laughing and there was so much pink confetti like this pink confetti rained for like the whole show it also just feels extremely accessible if you're someone that doesn't think they understand Shakespeare I think you would still like this production but I'm so glad I got to go I’m so glad we splurged on these second row tickets I'll never doubt you again Jamie Lloyd
reasoning: Creator expresses unreserved enthusiasm, calling it maybe her favorite version of the play ever, praising cast, direction, and accessibility, and saying she'll never doubt Jamie Lloyd again.
keyQuote: Jamie Lloyd has directed maybe my favorite version of it ever
